title: Sip & Sgraffito
commitment: One evening session, 7-9 pm (October 2, December 4, or February 5)
cost_text: $20 materials fee payable to the instructor
summary: Carve sgraffito designs into pre-made pottery and leave your piece for kiln firing. Finished work ready for pickup two weeks later; no experience needed.
source_quote: Sip & Sgraffito. Enjoy a relaxing evening sipping hot chocolate or tea while carving thoughtful designs into pre-made pottery by Janna and Zachary. Learn the sgraffito technique—scratching through colored slip to reveal the clay beneath—and leave your piece for firing. Finished work ready for pickup two weeks later.
evidence_sentence: Participants carve designs into pre-made pottery and leave their piece for kiln firing.
